column3: The entrusted property is described with an explicit image of the hand.
“Fifths” is plural, and the day is called the day of his guilt without an explicit verb of acknowledgment.
The valuation is addressed directly to “you.”
Putting on is repeated for the two garments; the undergarments are put on his flesh.
Oil is named without specifying olive oil; the priest is not explicitly named in this verse.
